title: Wealth Company Launches Category III AIF in GIFT City for NRI Mutual Fund Investments
summary: Wealth Company launched Category III AIF ('Wealth Company IFSC FoF') in GIFT City IFSC for NRIs to invest in Indian MFs and ETFs.

blocks.title: 📰 3. 🏦 BANKING & INSURANCE NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 Wealth Company Launches Category III AIF in GIFT City for NRI Mutual Fund Investments. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Wealth Company launched Category III AIF ('Wealth Company IFSC FoF') in GIFT City IFSC for NRIs to invest in Indian MFs and ETFs.
**Fund Vehicle:** 'The Wealth Company IFSC FoF' registered as open-ended **Category III Alternative Investment Fund (AIF)**.
**Regulator & Manager:** Managed by Wealth Company Asset Management IFSC branch registered with **IFSCA**.
⚠️ **AIF Category:** Registered specifically as Category III AIF (Fund of Funds).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on institutional financial products, interest margins, capital adequacy ratios, and digital payment infrastructure.
